end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
Matched dice, brick, rolling pin, flour container, lemon and other objects to 3D shapes.
Explained that a cube has equal faces and a cuboid has longer and wider faces.
Distinguished a sphere from a circle using football and roti examples.
Teach-back was not completed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming and matching 3D shapes through familiar objects and prompts about their faces and surfaces. Ishita explained the difference between a sphere and a circle and matched examples such as a rolling pin, flour container and lemon. Ishita requested pictures during the activity, so at home you can use real objects or photos to ask, “Which 3D shape is this?” They also asked for a game; a short shape-sorting game may help keep practice engaging.
